Step 8 of the AI-assisted IT ticketing workflow: turn a specialist solution into a customer-facing email response.

## Layout

```text
skills/draft-specialist-response/
├── SKILL.md
├── README.qmd
├── install.sh
└── scripts/
    └── draft_specialist_response.py
```

## Install

```bash
bash skills/draft-specialist-response/install.sh
```

## Usage through Claude

> "Draft the specialist response for TKT-00042."

Claude reads `SKILL.md`, verifies a specialist solution exists, runs the script, and reports the draft + any quality-check warnings.

## Direct CLI

```bash
uv run python skills/draft-specialist-response/scripts/draft_specialist_response.py --ticket-id TKT-00042
```

The script appends one row to `data/working/customer_response_drafts.csv` with `message_source=specialist_solution`.

## Public functions

- `load_specialist_response_context(data_dir, out_dir, ticket_id)` — loads ticket, latest specialist solution, and originating escalation; raises `LookupError` if no specialist solution.
- `draft_specialist_response(context)` — pure dict → dict. Builds `draft_text`, `sent_text`, `customer_action_required`, `follow_up_request`, `included_context`, and a `is_post_rejection` flag.
- `quality_check_response(draft)` — flags missing fields, internal-only phrasing, and (for post-rejection drafts) missing apology.
- `build_response_row(context)` — full row.
- `write_customer_response(out_dir, response)`.
- `main(argv)` — CLI. Exits 2 on missing ticket, 3 on missing specialist solution.

## Refusal behavior

The script refuses to draft when no specialist-solution row exists for the ticket. It exits 3 and asks the caller to run `investigate-specialist-solution` first.

## Test

```bash
uv run pytest tests/skills/test_draft_specialist_response.py -v
```
